summary: fix(settings): default Nova theme to system when none is stored
description:
Because:
- Nova users with no stored theme got light mode, not the OS theme.

This commit:
- Makes getStoredTheme() fall back to 'system' under Nova.
- Keeps 'light' as the fallback outside Nova.
- Adds unit tests for the Nova fallback cases.

Closes: FXA-15097
